q1_issues.issue: The of-phrase in 'the weight of the feather harvest' is attached with the nominalization-object oblique (Of ...), but it fails that route's stated verb-paraphrase test ('the weight of the harvest' is not 'what weighs the harvest' — the harvest is weigh's subject, not its object), so the ordinary genitive Possession is what the rules assign.

q2_gaps: A dimension/attribute noun used referentially with no magnitude ('the weight of X'): the Measure family requires a stated number and unit, and the of-phrase taxonomy (partitive / measure / about-phrase / nominalization-object / genitive) has no explicit slot for an attribute noun whose of-NP is the underlying stative subject.
notes: 'The Keepers' correctly takes the capitalized-plural-label Name-only treatment (no GroupOf, no per-member kind); feather_harvest fusion plus genus, Theme for the recording verb 'track', and the unmarked habitual present are all right.
